findings.title: Retention check allows zero-day retention
findings.body: The check `days < MIN_RETENTION_DAYS` allows `days == 0`, which would delete all uploads immediately. Retention must be at least one day to avoid accidental data loss. Change the comparison to `days <= MIN_RETENTION_DAYS`.
findings.suggestion:
if days <= MIN_RETENTION_DAYS:
        raise ValueError(f"retention below {MIN_RETENTION_DAYS} days is not allowed")

findings.title: Missing count increment in purge_older_than
findings.body: The function `purge_older_than` increments `removed` after each deletion in the full file, but the diff only shows the deletion call. This omission makes the return value incorrect and breaks the caller's accounting. Add `removed += 1` after `delete(name)`.

summary.problem: The retention check allows zero-day retention and the purge function omits a count increment, breaking accounting.
summary.done_well: A minimum retention threshold is enforced and the function signature matches its documented behavior.
